name: F1 1990
author: Swofty
description: Adds a 1990 Driver Career next to the 2025 and 2026 ones: 1990 teams, drivers, calendar, rules and cars. Every other mode stays stock. Private test content: the car models are Codemasters classics from Jefry. Not for release.

options.label: Silent agent in 1990 careers
options.description: Mutes the agent's voice lines (subtitles stay) in 1990 careers only; 2025 and 2026 careers keep her voice.

options.label: 1990 power-unit rules
options.description: No power-unit wear and no power-unit grid penalties for the 1990 cars (f1_1990 and f1_1990b packages); every other car keeps the stock rules.

options.label: 1990 power-unit parts
options.description: In 1990 careers the power-unit screens list 1990 parts: Engine, Qualifying Engine, Clutch, Fuel System, Electronics and the gearbox. The qualifying engine wears in Qualifying 1 and 2 only.

options.label: 1990 qualifying engines
options.description: The qualifying engine R&D lines add their Engine Power only in Friday and Saturday qualifying of a 1990 career.

options.label: 1990 qualifying lap limit
options.description: Each car may start 12 laps in each qualifying session of a 1990 career; a car that has used them is sent to its pit box. A race HUD message shows the laps left.

options.label: 1990 pit stop crew pace
options.description: In 1990 races the crew works at normal speed and the longer 1990 stop is spent holding the wheel guns on and lowering the jacks slowly; off plays the whole stop in slow motion.

options.label: 1990 R&D colours and icons
options.description: Gives each R&D department a 1990 colour and a period icon in 1990 careers only; 2025 and 2026 careers keep the stock look.

options.label: 1990 Career tile
options.description: Adds a 1990 Career tile next to the 2025 and 2026 Career tiles.

options.label: 1990 career setup
options.description: A new 1990 Driver Career goes from the settings straight to Choose Driver with the 1990 drivers: no F2 start, season length, team, driver icons or driver type step. 2025 and 2026 careers keep every step.

options.label: 1990 intro video
options.description: A new 1990 Driver Career opens with the intro video in place of the agent's intro cutscene, skippable like the stock videos. Without the video file the career starts as before.

options.label: 1990 session names
options.description: In a 1990 career the Friday session is Qualifying 1 and the Saturday session Qualifying 2. Needs the core's runtime string overrides (API v8).

options.label: Dry tyres in Friday qualifying
options.description: At the start of Friday qualifying, makes every unused dry set usable (the game hands them back and only allows inters and wets there). Not needed when no_tyre_allocation turns the allocation off.

options.label: Qualifying tyres in qualifying only
options.description: At the start of a 1990 race, every car hands back its unused qualifying tyre sets, so the race runs on race tyres as in 1990.

options.label: Tyre fallback
options.description: In 1990 sessions, a car whose weekend allocation has no sets gets a copy of another car's sets, and a car that finds no tyre to fit may use its unused sets of other sessions. Logs each change.

options.label: 1990 tyre badges in the garage and HUD
options.description: In a 1990 career the cars take the 1990 compound class when they are created, so the garage tyre picker, the HUD, the MFD and the timing tower show the SS / US / S badges. The physical compounds stay the same. Logs the change.

options.label: Replay room for 26 cars
options.description: Moves a replay recorder state that outgrows its buffer (per-car systems at the 26-car race start) to a larger buffer. Does nothing while every state fits, as on a 22-car grid.

options.label: Test cars in Grand Prix
options.description: Test only, off by default (Grand Prix stays stock): puts 1990 cars on the F1 2026 Grand Prix grid: Ferrari seats, all 22, Larrousse/Dallara on the Williams/Haas seats, or all 22 B-spec cars.

options.label: Cars
options.description: Cars on the 1990 grid. 22 runs the 11 strongest teams; 26 adds Larrousse and Dallara and needs 26-car track layers.

options.label: Career year
options.description: The year the career calendar runs in. 2026 puts each race on the Sunday 3 days before its 1990 date, with birth years moved so driver ages match 1990. 1990 gives a season without races.

options.label: 1990 engine sounds
options.description: The engine sound of the 1990 cars. 1990 plays the V12, V10 and V8 bundles of the F1 25 Engine Sound Pack; 2026 plays the donor team's stock 2026 engine.

options.label: Race tyre sets per session
options.description: Soft race sets, and as many race sets, for practice 1, practice 2 and the race of a 1990 weekend (Balanced allocation; Softer and Harder move one set). At most 3: 9 usable sets of a compound.

options.label: Qualifying tyre sets per session
options.description: Qualifying tyre sets for Friday and for Saturday qualifying of a 1990 weekend; 1990 allowed 2. Unused sets carry over to Saturday. At most 4: 9 usable sets of a compound.

options.label: Tyre supplier
options.description: 1990: each team on its 1990 supplier (Pirelli: Tyrrell, Minardi, Brabham, Dallara). Goodyear lasts longer; Pirelli has a quicker peak and wears sooner. All Goodyear or All Pirelli: every team.

options.label: No weekend tyre allocation
options.description: Turns off the weekend tyre allocation screen for the 1990 compound class, as the classic class does. Test switch for the Friday qualifying tyre problem.

options.label: Pre-race grid cutscene
options.description: Plays the grid cutscene before a 1990 race start, which brings the safety car onto the grid.

options.label: Pre-race grid rundown
options.description: Plays the camera run down the grid before a 1990 race start, which ends on the safety car.

options.label: Steering wheel display
options.description: The dial the 1990 cars show: the F2 dial, with no ERS or override readouts, or the modern F1 dial.

options.label: No active aero
options.description: Turns off the 2026 active aero rules on the 1990 cars (the f1_1990 vehicle package).

options.label: ERS
options.description: Removed takes the hybrid system out of the cars. Zeroed keeps it with no harvest, deploy or override, for when removal misbehaves. Stock keeps the 2026 hybrid system as it is. None of them changes mass or engine power.

options.label: Tyre size
options.description: Tyre radius of the 1990 handling files, each 30 mm above the 2026 ride height. 2026 keeps the 2026 radius, 13-inch uses the 13-inch radius; Raised lifts it 2.4 to 2.8 cm more. Stock 2026 handling is a test value.

options.label: Handling
options.description: 1990: period engines (620-690 hp), mass and drag (620 kg, drag x1.25), downforce x0.75, grip 0.915/0.925, heavier wheel. 1990, low grip: same, downforce x0.5, grip 0.83/0.85. Modern: earlier handling.

options.label: B-spec cars
options.description: In 1990 careers, a team whose B-spec R&D milestone is complete races its B-spec car from the next session on (AI teams too).
